_comment: List prices in USD per million tokens as of 2026-10-23. These are published list prices, not your bill: please update them yourself (--prices FILE or ~/.config/token-autopsy/prices.json). First entry whose 'match' substring is in the model name wins. cache_write is the 5-minute write price (1.25x input); cache_write_1h defaults to 2x input when omitted.
